Container.Name: dwellmind-ha
Container.Overview: DwellMind HA — local-first room intelligence for Home Assistant. Early alpha: bounded observation and offline reports only. No device control, web UI, or continuous training service. The default five-minute capture exits normally and writes a private report to appdata/reports. Configure your actual room entity IDs. Template token fields are masked, NOT encrypted: Docker administrators and saved Unraid templates can read them. Use a dedicated HA account; a normal HA token is not intrinsically read-only. See project documentation before deployment.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Private captures and reports. Use a new empty directory for first install; existing data is never recursively chowned. 64-run retention cap.

Config.Name: Home Assistant URL
Config.Description: Fixed HA origin, e.g. https://ha.example.internal:8123. No path, query, or credentials.

Config.Name: HA token (private)
Config.Description: Enter locally. Masked only; stored in Unraid/Docker configuration. Leave blank when using HA_TOKEN_FILE. Never post saved templates or docker inspect output.

Config.Name: Allow plaintext HA connection
Config.Description: true explicitly permits http/ws, transmitting your HA token without encryption. Prefer HTTPS.

Config.Name: Rooms
Config.Description: office, living_room, or office,living_room. Roles below must match actual entities; labels are not HA area IDs.

Config.Name: Capture seconds
Config.Description: 10–86400 seconds. Default five-minute validation run; container stops afterwards. This is intentional.

Config.Name: Maximum receive attempts
Config.Description: 20–100000. Includes idle receive timeouts. Bounds each capture; may stop before duration.

Config.Name: Reconnect limit
Config.Description: 0–10 retries; authentication or entity permission denial stops without elevation.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Non-root capture UID. Default Unraid nobody. Root only initializes an empty mount, then drops privileges before network access.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Capture GID; default Unraid users.

Config.Name: Office primary light
Config.Description: Actual light entity ID; sample must be replaced if different.

Config.Name: Office other light
Config.Description: Distinct secondary light ID. Current alpha expects both light roles.

Config.Name: Office PIR
Config.Description: Physical motion binary sensor, not a derived helper.

Config.Name: Office mmWave
Config.Description: Physical presence binary sensor.

Config.Name: Office derived occupancy
Config.Description: Combined/helper binary sensor; kept separate from physical evidence.

Config.Name: Office illuminance
Config.Description: Numeric illuminance sensor.

Config.Name: Living Room primary light
Config.Description: Actual ceiling/main light ID.

Config.Name: Living Room other light
Config.Description: Distinct standing/accent lamp ID.

Config.Name: Living Room PIR
Config.Description: Physical motion binary sensor.

Config.Name: Living Room mmWave
Config.Description: Physical presence binary sensor.

Config.Name: Living Room derived occupancy
Config.Description: Combined/helper binary sensor.

Config.Name: Living Room illuminance
Config.Description: Numeric illuminance sensor.

Config.Name: Living Room TV (optional)
Config.Description: Only media state, never title or content URL. Clear to disable media observation.

Config.Name: Engine source entities
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated automation/script IDs belonging to a future learner. Their actions are marked engine, never preference labels.
